name: flight.k
model:
package examples {

annotation doc : String

class Airplane {
  var engines:Seq[Engine]
  val controller:FlightController
  val leftWing:Wing
  val rightWing:Wing
  val landing:Bool
  val takeoff:Bool
  var speed:Real
  var flaps:Real

  req landing || landing

  req takeoff || takeoff

  req LandingFlaps: landing => (flaps > 15)

  req TakeoffFlaps: takeoff => flaps <= 15

  req TakeoffSpeed: takeoff => (flaps = 10) && (speed > 63) && (speed < 74)

  req LandingSpeed: landing => ((flaps = 16) && (speed > 40) && (speed < 54))
}

class Wing

class Engine

class Actuator {
  var value:Real

  fun read

}

class FlightController {
  val act1:Actuator
  val act2:Actuator

  req ActuatorAvg: (act1.value + act2.value) / 2E0 <= 3.14E-2
}


}
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((Airplane (mk-Airplane (engines (Seq Ref))(controller Ref)(leftWing Ref)(rightWing Ref)(landing Bool)(takeoff Bool)(speed Real)(flaps Real)))))
(declare-sort Wing) (declare-const mk-Wing Wing)
(declare-sort Engine) (declare-const mk-Engine Engine)
(declare-datatypes () ((Actuator (mk-Actuator (value Real)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((FlightController (mk-FlightController (act1 Ref)(act2 Ref)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-Airplane (sel-Airplane Airplane))
  (lift-Wing (sel-Wing Wing))
  (lift-Engine (sel-Engine Engine))
  (lift-Actuator (sel-Actuator Actuator))
  (lift-FlightController (sel-FlightController FlightController))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-Airplane ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Airplane (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Airplane ((this Ref)) Airplane
  (sel-Airplane (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Wing ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Wing (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Wing ((this Ref)) Wing
  (sel-Wing (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Engine ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Engine (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Engine ((this Ref)) Engine
  (sel-Engine (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Actuator ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Actuator (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Actuator ((this Ref)) Actuator
  (sel-Actuator (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-FlightController ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-FlightController (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-FlightController ((this Ref)) FlightController
  (sel-FlightController (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-Airplane ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Airplane this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Wing ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Wing this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Engine ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Engine this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Actuator ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Actuator this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-FlightController ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-FlightController this)
)

; ================

; ================

; -------------------------------

; --- getters for Airplane.engines: ---

(define-fun Airplane!engines ((this Ref)) (Seq Ref)

)

(define-fun Airplane!controller ((this Ref)) Ref

)

(define-fun Airplane!leftWing ((this Ref)) Ref

; --- getters for Airplane.flaps: ---

)

; -------------------------------
;   Getters for class Actuator:
; -------------------------------

; --- getters for Actuator.value: ---

(define-fun Actuator.value ((this Ref)) Real
  (value (deref-Actuator this))
)

; ---------------------------------------
;   Getters for class FlightController:
; ---------------------------------------

; --- getters for FlightController.act1: ---

(define-fun FlightController!act1 ((this Ref)) Ref

)

; --- getters for FlightController.act2: ---

(define-fun FlightController!act2 ((this Ref)) Ref

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------
;   Methods for class Actuator:
; -------------------------------

(define-fun Actuator.read ((this Ref)) Bool
  true
)

(define-fun Actuator!read ((this Ref)) Bool
  true
)

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

;   Invariant for class Airplane:

(declare-const const-6-Airplane Airplane)

(define-fun Airplane.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-FlightController (Airplane!controller this))
)

(assert (! (Airplane.inv1 6) :named _xkassert0))

(define-fun Airplane.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool

  (=> (> (seq.len (Airplane!engines this)) 6) (or (= (seq.nth (Airplane!engines this) 6) 7)))

  (=> (> (seq.len (Airplane!engines this)) 7) (or (= (seq.nth (Airplane!engines this) 7) 7)))
